scope: Additional clock-driven simulated mtime. No formal score (<10s target time).
clock_rule: At rising edge N after reset: counter sample = N-1; one-edge registered memory read supplied to MEM at edge N is N-2; high word zero during bounded run.
reference_rule: Check each accepted timer read address/value against fixed clock rule; sequential ISA model consumes computed rule values in independent instruction order, not DUT data. Fixed CRC/main return and full streams/state required.
